lines.en: Every step clinks my spikes.
My back carries spikes and plates.
I walk steadily on four legs.
I follow the shrub line.
My tail drags a trail of spikes.
Head down, I hunt for the next clump of fern.

lines.zh: 我经过带刺的树会停下
lines.en: I pause at thorny trees.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但很有分量
lines.en: Slow, but weighty.
I chew leaves as I walk.
I head for the thorny patches.
My steps land dull and heavy.
I flick my tail.
I patrol this scrub.
I steer clear of the deep water.
I stand here grinding up fern fronds.
The plates on my back soak up the heat.

lines.zh: 我不动，像一丛带刺的灌木
lines.en: Still, I look like thorny scrub.
I looked up for a while.
I grind my teeth slowly.
My spiked tail tip hangs down.
The wind whistles through the gaps between my plates.
I drew my neck in a little.
I need fear nothing at all.
I sway my tail in place.
I narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 我闻到远处有别的恐龙
lines.en: I smell another dinosaur far off.
I breathe hard, air snorting from my nostrils.
I wait for someone to touch the thorns.
You are nearing the thorns.
Do not put your hand among the thorns.
I lowered my neck a little.
What do you intend to do?
The spikes on my back rose.
Do not touch that thicket.
I know your shape.
I swing my whole spiked back toward you.
I watch you without hostility.
You wear no armor.
I took a step; you stepped back.
A dull rumble squeezes out of my throat.
I shake my head; the spikes rattle.
I shifted my body aside.

lines.zh: 你的力道只到这层厚皮
lines.en: Your force stops at this thick hide.
I do not cry; I only bellow low.
One plate dented.
Turning takes me a while.
I did not run a single step.
Do you want to try again?
My tail stiffened.
I chalk this blow up on my spikes.
I can eat these leaves.
Is that fern you're clutching in your fist?
I prefer thorny shrubs.
Set it down on the ground.
I sway over to you one step at a time.
That is not enough to chew.
Step back first.
It smells acceptable.
I won't bump you, only sniff it.
Do not put your hand in my mouth.
You hit my spikes.
I did not move aside at all.
My bones are heavy.
You backed off two steps running.
Something got scratched.
I lumber around, turning my bulk.
I did not mean to bump you.
This shoulder of mine is hard.
Go around next time.
I keep chewing my leaves and ignore you.
This is the quiet season.
My spikes are not for display.
There's no hurrying the egg business.
Let me finish these leaves first.
I'm not ready to come any closer.
My spikes are not your kind of scales.
My tail tip swayed once.
I am not interested.
Get away from here.
I only want to bask.
I dip my head and grip it.
My forelimbs are too short.
This thing pricks my mouth.
I pick it up and drop it back in the dirt.
Is this yours?

lines.zh: 我用吻端把它拱到你脚边
lines.en: I nudge it to your feet with my snout.
It caught on my spikes.
I shook it off.
Do not walk by my spikes.
You would be quicker yourself.
You touched that thicket.
I saw all of that.
I guard these thorny ones.
Leave this thicket and it is over.
I lift a leg and step over.
I lower my head and point it at you.
This is no misunderstanding.
I have fixed on you.
Will you touch them again?
I close on you with heavy, deliberate steps.
My tail has risen.
Step back, or my tail comes around.
I guard the trees, not you.

lines.zh: 你碰刺的地方我记住了
lines.en: I've marked the spot where you touched my thorns.
I tread the soil you crossed.
You still carry that tool.
I stand before the thicket.
You cannot get around this patch.
I am much wider than you.
My spikes point at you.
No hurry; I graze.
Do not pretend you were passing by.

lines.zh: 你退到哪儿我都看得见
lines.en: Wherever you retreat, I see it.
This scrub is mine.
I wait for you to try again.
There are thorns all around your feet.
I do not chase very fast.
You will not leave this wood.
I am in no rush at all.
I swing my tail across.
A blow lined with spikes.
You are swept backward.
My tail is heavier than my head.
You guarded your legs.
My tail club only grazes your shoulder.
My spikes tore your sleeve.
You retreated in time.
I am not usually like this.
The next will be truer.
You fell; I do not press.
I let out a low bellow.
This strike is your lesson.
I have turned away.
I rise out of the scrub.
My spikes show first.

lines.zh: 这片林地多了一只大的
lines.en: The wood has one large creature more.
My plates catch the light first.
I snapped a few dry twigs.
I smell damp earth.
This is a Late Jurassic wood.
I shake off the dirt.
I hatched long ago.
The plates on my back still grow.
I am in no hurry to move off.

lines.zh: 你听见低沉的脚步了吗
lines.en: Do you hear the low footsteps?
I take a couple of bites first.
I head for the thorny growth.

lines.zh: 我从土里拱出来，抬头看你
lines.en: I dig out of the soil and look up at you.
I feel safe here.
My tail sweeps the grass.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一堵带刺的墙
lines.en: I stand like a wall of thorns.
Fire scorched my spike tips.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下，摔在刺上
lines.en: I slid down and landed on my own spikes.

lines.zh: 水太深，我的脚够不到底
lines.en: The water is too deep for my feet.
The blast forced me to crouch.
The arrow glanced off my plates.

lines.zh: 法术一缠，我跪了半条腿
lines.en: The spell coils my leg and I buckle halfway down.

lines.zh: 这一片叶子被我吃光了
lines.en: I have eaten this patch bare.
Lightning struck my tail tip.
There is not even soil here.
